findings.reason: the clause is unmeasurable at one of its two arms until the plan names how the base rows are obtained, whether that is a longer job or a reduced comparison set.
findings.text: done-when (2) requires the built jet rows to match "the base build at every node at both arms", but §3's own comment (line 95) records that the 2,132-node base run reproduced the compile at 7,013 s then held ~378 GB through ~11,000 s of node loop "without publishing the operand", so the base rows this clause compares against do not exist and no clause says how to produce them
